```{r setup, include=FALSE, eval=TRUE}

library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(ggrepel)
library(TwoSampleMR)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "C:/Users/P018906/OneDrive - Amsterdam UMC/Documents/AMC bridge/ICC4/results")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, error=FALSE)
```

# Mirror plot ever use

We start with a mirror Manhattan plot (Miami plot) for the trans-ancestry and European results for ever use of cannabis.

## Europeans

The summary statistics are formatted and top SNPs are identified using clumping. For the X-chromosome, the risk loci were filtered out because they were not present in the reference data. We added them and manually clumped them based on proximity. Note that loci that were too close to each other were pruned further (even if they were genome-wide significant) for visibility.

```{r, eval = F}

CANNABIS_EVR <- fread("metal/MA_CANNABIS_EVR_250919.txt.gz")
CANNABIS_EVR_X <- fread("metal/MA_CANNABIS_EVR_X_250409.txt")
CANNABIS_EVR <- rbind(CANNABIS_EVR, CANNABIS_EVR_X) %>% 
  mutate(CHR = ifelse(CHR == "X", 23, CHR),
         CHR = as.numeric(CHR))

CANNABIS_EVR_cum <- CANNABIS_EVR %>% 
  group_by(CHR) %>% 
  summarise(max_bp = max(BP)) %>% 
  mutate(bp_add = lag(cumsum(as.numeric(max_bp)), default = 0)) %>% 
  select(CHR, bp_add)

CANNABIS_EVR_data <- CANNABIS_EVR %>% 
  inner_join(CANNABIS_EVR_cum, by = "CHR") %>% 
  mutate(bp_cum = BP + bp_add) %>%
  mutate(uniqID = paste(CHR, BP, A1, A2, sep = ":"))

axis_set <- CANNABIS_EVR_data %>% 
  group_by(CHR) %>% 
  summarize(center = mean(bp_cum))

ylim <- CANNABIS_EVR_data %>% 
  filter(P == min(P)) %>% 
  mutate(ylim = -1 * abs(floor(log10(P)))) %>% 
  pull(ylim)

ylim <- ylim - 2

sig <- 5e-8

# Clump hits

CANNABIS_top <- CANNABIS_EVR %>% 
  filter(P<5e-8) %>% 
  rename(effect_allele = A1) %>% 
  rename(other_allele = A2) %>% 
  rename(eaf=EAF) %>% 
  rename(beta=BETA) %>% 
  rename(se=SE) %>% 
  rename(pval=P) %>% 
  rename(samplesize=N) 

fwrite(CANNABIS_top, "metal/CANNABIS_EVR.hits", sep=" ", quote=F, na=NA)

CANNABIS_top <- read_exposure_data("metal/CANNABIS_EVR.hits")
CANNABIS_top <- clump_data(
  CANNABIS_top,
  clump_kb = 10000,
  clump_r2 = 0.01,
  bfile = "/1000genomes/1kg.v3/EUR",
  plink_bin = "/genetics.binaRies/bin/plink"
)

CANNABIS_top <- CANNABIS_top %>% 
  select(SNP) %>% 
  left_join(CANNABIS_EVR_data) 

CANNABIS_top_nonoverlapping <- CANNABIS_top %>%
  arrange(P) %>%  
  group_by(CHR) %>%  
  do({
    snps <- .
    kept <- c()
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(snps))) {
      pos <- snps$bp_cum[i]
      if (all(abs(pos - snps$bp_cum[kept]) > 15000000)) {
        kept <- c(kept, i)
      }
    }
    snps[kept, ]
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# SNPs that overlap with other labels after ggrepel are plotted separately
CANNABIS_top_nonoverlapping <- CANNABIS_top_nonoverlapping %>% filter(SNP != "rs62389423" & SNP != "rs4856598" & SNP != "rs113367058" & SNP != "rs1061808")


## X SNPs are not in clump reference file so add those manually

CANNABIS_top_X <- CANNABIS_EVR_data %>% 
  filter(CHR == 23 & P<5e-8)

CANNABIS_top_X$bp_bin <- cut(
  CANNABIS_top_X$bp_cum,
  breaks = quantile(CANNABIS_top_X$bp_cum, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 10), na.rm = TRUE),
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  labels = FALSE
)

CANNABIS_top_X <- CANNABIS_top_X %>% 
  filter(bp_bin == 1 | bp_bin == 9) %>% 
  group_by(bp_bin) %>% 
  arrange(P) %>% 
  slice(1)



# Add genes mapped positionally with FUMA

CANNABIS_EVR_genes <- fread("fuma/CANNABIS_EVR_genes.txt")

CANNABIS_EVR_genes_cum <- CANNABIS_EVR_genes %>% 
  rename(CHR = chr) %>% 
  filter(minGwasP <5e-8) %>% 
  mutate(mid = end - ((end - start)/2)) %>%   
  left_join(CANNABIS_EVR_cum, by = "CHR") %>% 
  mutate(bp_cum = mid + bp_add) 

## group loci that are close
threshold <- 10000000

CANNABIS_EVR_genes_top <- CANNABIS_EVR_genes_cum %>%
  group_by(CHR) %>%
  arrange(bp_cum) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = cumsum(ifelse(is.na(lag(bp_cum)) | (bp_cum - lag(bp_cum) > threshold), 1, 0))
  ) %>%
  group_by(CHR, Group) %>% 
  arrange(minGwasP, .by_group = T) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup()

# make some lines for exact gene position

dashedlines <- CANNABIS_EVR_genes_cum %>% 
  select(bp_cum)

x_coordinates <- eval(parse(text = as.character(dashedlines)))
```

Then the plot is drawn and annotated:

```{r, eval = F}


png("metal/CANNABIS_EVR_eur_manh.png", width=190, height=60, units="mm", res=1000)
ggplot(CANNABIS_EVR_data, aes(x = bp_cum, y = log10(P), color = as_factor(CHR), size = log10(P))) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = log10(sig), color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = x_coordinates, linetype = "dashed", color = "lightgrey", linewidth = 0.2) + 
  
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(label = axis_set$CHR, 
                     breaks = axis_set$center,
                     position = "top", 
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(ylim, 0),
                  clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = pretty(c(ylim, 0)),
    labels = function(b) abs(b) 
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = rep(c("#88d631", "#517f1c"), length(unique(axis_set$CHR)))) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5,3)) +
  labs(x = NULL, 
       y = bquote(-log[10](italic(p)))) + 
  
  theme_classic() +
  theme( 
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = 0.5),
    text = element_text(size = 6.5),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 30, 5, 30)
  ) +
  
  geom_text(data=CANNABIS_top_nonoverlapping, 
            aes(x=bp_cum, y = log10(P)),
            label = "\U25C7",
            color="#a6761d",
            size = 3
  ) +
  
  geom_text_repel(
    data = CANNABIS_top_nonoverlapping,
    aes(x = bp_cum, y = log10(P) - 1, label = SNP),
    color = "grey30",
    size = 1.5,
    angle = 90,
    direction = "y",
    hjust = 1,
    box.padding = 0.3,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    force = 2,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    ylim = c(ylim+5, 0),  
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  
  geom_text(
    data = CANNABIS_EVR_genes_top,
    aes(x = bp_cum, y = ylim-2, label = symbol),
    color = "#476f19",
    size = 1.5,
    angle = 90,
    vjust = 1,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  
  geom_text(data=subset(CANNABIS_top, SNP == "rs1061808"),
            aes(x = bp_cum - 30000000, y = log10(P)-2, label = SNP),
            color = "grey30",
            size = 1.5,
            angle = 90,
            hjust = 0
            ) +
  
  geom_text(data=subset(CANNABIS_top, SNP == "rs1061808"), 
            aes(x=bp_cum, y = log10(P)),
            label = "\U25C7",
            color="#a6761d",
            size = 3
  ) +
  
  geom_text(data=subset(CANNABIS_top, SNP == "rs4856598"),
            aes(x = bp_cum - 30000000, y = log10(P), label = SNP),
            color = "grey30",
            size = 1.5,
            angle = 90,
            hjust = 0
  ) +
  
  geom_text(data=subset(CANNABIS_top, SNP == "rs4856598"), 
            aes(x=bp_cum, y = log10(P)),
            label = "\U25C7",
            color="#a6761d",
            size = 3
  ) +
  
  geom_text(data=subset(CANNABIS_top, SNP == "rs113367058"),
            aes(x = bp_cum, y = log10(P) - 11, label = SNP),
            color = "grey30",
            size = 1.5,
            angle = 90,
            hjust = 0
  ) +
  
  geom_text(data=subset(CANNABIS_top, SNP == "rs113367058"), 
            aes(x=bp_cum, y = log10(P)),
            label = "\U25C7",
            color="#a6761d",
            size = 3
  ) +
  
  geom_text(data=CANNABIS_top_X,
            aes(x = bp_cum, y = log10(P) - 6, label = SNP),
            color = "grey30",
            size = 1.5,
            angle = 90,
            hjust = 0) +
  
  geom_text(data=CANNABIS_top_X, 
            aes(x=bp_cum, y = log10(P)),
            label = "\U25C7",
            color="#a6761d",
            size = 3
  ) 

dev.off()

fwrite(CANNABIS_top, "metal/CANNABIS_EVR_eur_tophits.csv")
fwrite(CANNABIS_top_X, "metal/CANNABIS_EVR_eur_topX.csv")


```

## Trans-ancestry

Now prepare the dataframe for the trans-ancestry results in the same manner. There were no hits on chromosome X for this analysis.

```{r, eval = F}


### Trans ancestry

CANNABIS_EVR <- fread("metal/MA_CANNABIS_EVR_cross_250919.txt.gz")

CANNABIS_EVR_cum <- CANNABIS_EVR %>% 
  mutate(CHR = ifelse(CHR == "X", 23, CHR)) %>% 
  mutate(CHR = as.numeric(CHR)) %>% 
  group_by(CHR) %>% 
  summarise(max_bp = max(BP)) %>% 
  mutate(bp_add = lag(cumsum(as.numeric(max_bp)), default = 0)) %>% 
  select(CHR, bp_add)

CANNABIS_EVR_data <- CANNABIS_EVR %>% 
  mutate(CHR = ifelse(CHR == "X", 23, CHR)) %>% 
  mutate(CHR = as.numeric(CHR)) %>% 
  inner_join(CANNABIS_EVR_cum, by = "CHR") %>% 
  mutate(bp_cum = BP + bp_add) %>%
  mutate(uniqID = paste(CHR, BP, A1, A2, sep = ":"))

axis_set <- CANNABIS_EVR_data %>% 
  group_by(CHR) %>% 
  summarize(center = mean(bp_cum))

ylim <- CANNABIS_EVR_data %>% 
  filter(P == min(P)) %>% 
  mutate(ylim = abs(floor(log10(P))) + 10.5) %>% 
  pull(ylim)

ylim <- 30

sig <- 5e-8

# Use hits clumped with FUMA

CANNABIS_top <- fread("fuma/CANNABIS_EVR_cross_riskloci.txt")

CANNABIS_top <- CANNABIS_top %>% 
  rename(SNP = rsID) %>% 
  select(SNP) %>% 
  left_join(CANNABIS_EVR_data) 

CANNABIS_top_nonoverlapping <- CANNABIS_top %>%
  arrange(P) %>%  
  group_by(CHR) %>%  
  do({
    snps <- .
    kept <- c()
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(snps))) {
      pos <- snps$bp_cum[i]
      if (all(abs(pos - snps$bp_cum[kept]) > 15000000)) {
        kept <- c(kept, i)
      }
    }
    snps[kept, ]
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# SNPs that overlap with other labels after ggrepel are plotted separately
CANNABIS_top_nonoverlapping <- CANNABIS_top_nonoverlapping %>% filter(SNP != "rs34676049" & SNP != "rs956281")


# Add genes mapped positionally with FUMA

CANNABIS_EVR_genes <- fread("fuma/CANNABIS_EVR_cross_genes.txt")

CANNABIS_EVR_genes_cum <- CANNABIS_EVR_genes %>% 
  rename(CHR = chr) %>% 
  filter(minGwasP <5e-8) %>% 
  mutate(mid = end - ((end - start)/2)) %>%   
  left_join(CANNABIS_EVR_cum, by = "CHR") %>% 
  mutate(bp_cum = mid + bp_add) 

## group loci that are close
threshold <- 10000000

CANNABIS_EVR_genes_top <- CANNABIS_EVR_genes_cum %>%
  group_by(CHR) %>%
  arrange(bp_cum) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = cumsum(ifelse(is.na(lag(bp_cum)) | (bp_cum - lag(bp_cum) > threshold), 1, 0))
  ) %>%
  group_by(CHR, Group) %>% 
  arrange(minGwasP, .by_group = T) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup()





# make some lines for exact gene position

dashedlines <- CANNABIS_EVR_genes_cum %>% 
  select(bp_cum)

x_coordinates <- eval(parse(text = as.character(dashedlines)))

```

# Combined frequency 

For the Europeans, we combined the frequency summary statistics with Genomic SEM and ran a GWAS on this all-frequency phenotype. We follow the same procedure as before to prepare and plot the results.



```{r, eval = F}

frq <- fread("gsem/MA_FREQ_ALL_250919.txt.gz") 

frq_cum <- frq %>% 
  group_by(CHR) %>% 
  summarise(max_bp = max(BP)) %>% 
  mutate(bp_add = lag(cumsum(as.numeric(max_bp)), default = 0)) %>% 
  select(CHR, bp_add)

frq_data <- frq %>% 
  inner_join(frq_cum, by = "CHR") %>% 
  mutate(bp_cum = BP + bp_add) %>%
  mutate(uniqID = paste(CHR, BP, A1, A2, sep = ":"))

axis_set <- frq_data %>% 
  group_by(CHR) %>% 
  summarize(center = mean(bp_cum))

ylim <- frq_data %>% 
  filter(P == min(P)) %>% 
  mutate(ylim = abs(floor(log10(P))) + 5.5) %>% 
  pull(ylim)


sig <- 5e-8

# Clump hits

frq_top <- frq %>% 
  filter(P<5e-8) %>% 
  rename(effect_allele = A1) %>% 
  rename(other_allele = A2) %>% 
  rename(eaf=EAF) %>% 
  rename(beta=BETA) %>% 
  rename(se=SE) %>% 
  rename(pval=P) %>% 
  rename(samplesize=N) 

fwrite(frq_top, "gsem/FREQ_MA.hits", sep=" ", quote=F, na=NA)
frq_top <- read_exposure_data("gsem/FREQ_MA.hits")
frq_top <- clump_data(
  frq_top,
  clump_kb = 10000,
  clump_r2 = 0.01,
  bfile = "C:/Users/P018906/OneDrive - Amsterdam UMC/Documents/AMC bridge/1000genomes/1kg.v3/EUR",
  plink_bin = "C:/Users/P018906/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.3/genetics.binaRies/bin/plink"
)

frq_top <- frq_top %>% 
  select(SNP) %>% 
  left_join(frq_data) 

# Create df for genes

frq_genes <- fread("fuma/FREQ_MA_genes.txt")

frq_genes_cum <- frq_genes %>% 
  rename(CHR = chr) %>% 
  filter(minGwasP <5e-8) %>% 
  mutate(mid = end - ((end - start)/2)) %>%   
  left_join(CANNABIS_EVR_cum, by = "CHR") %>% 
  mutate(bp_cum = mid + bp_add) 


## group genes that are close
threshold <- 10000000

frq_genes_top <- frq_genes_cum %>%
  group_by(CHR) %>%
  arrange(bp_cum) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = cumsum(ifelse(is.na(lag(bp_cum)) | (bp_cum - lag(bp_cum) > threshold), 1, 0))
  ) %>%
  group_by(CHR, Group) %>% 
  arrange(minGwasP, .by_group = T) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup()

## Keep lines for all genes 
dashedlines <- frq_genes_cum %>% 
  select(bp_cum)

x_coordinates <- eval(parse(text = as.character(dashedlines)))

```

# All cannabis factor

We also ran a GWAS on a Genomic SEM model combining the frequency and ever use traits. It had many hits and required much pruning for displaying. 

```{r, eval = F}


factor <- fread("gsem/MA_CANN_FACTOR_250919.txt.gz") 

factor_cum <- factor %>% 
  group_by(CHR) %>% 
  summarise(max_bp = max(BP)) %>% 
  mutate(bp_add = lag(cumsum(as.numeric(max_bp)), default = 0)) %>% 
  select(CHR, bp_add)

factor_data <- factor %>% 
  inner_join(factor_cum, by = "CHR") %>% 
  mutate(bp_cum = BP + bp_add) %>%
  mutate(uniqID = paste(CHR, BP, A1, A2, sep = ":"))

axis_set <- factor_data %>% 
  group_by(CHR) %>% 
  summarize(center = mean(bp_cum))

ylim <- factor_data %>% 
  filter(P == min(P)) %>% 
  mutate(ylim = abs(floor(log10(P))) + 5.5) %>% 
  pull(ylim)


sig <- 5e-8

# Clump hits

factor_top <- factor %>% 
  filter(P<5e-8) %>% 
  rename(effect_allele = A1) %>% 
  rename(other_allele = A2) %>% 
  rename(eaf=EAF) %>% 
  rename(beta=BETA) %>% 
  rename(se=SE) %>% 
  rename(pval=P) %>% 
  rename(samplesize=N) 

fwrite(factor_top, "gsem/CANNABIS_FACTOR.hits", sep=" ", quote=F, na=NA)
factor_top <- read_exposure_data("gsem/CANNABIS_FACTOR.hits")
factor_top <- clump_data(
  factor_top,
  clump_kb = 10000,
  clump_r2 = 0.01,
  bfile = "C:/Users/P018906/OneDrive - Amsterdam UMC/Documents/AMC bridge/1000genomes/1kg.v3/EUR",
  plink_bin = "C:/Users/P018906/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.3/genetics.binaRies/bin/plink"
)

factor_top <- factor_top %>% 
  select(SNP) %>% 
  left_join(factor_data) 

factor_top_nonoverlapping <- factor_top %>%
  arrange(P) %>%  
  group_by(CHR) %>%  
  do({
    snps <- .
    kept <- c()
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(snps))) {
      pos <- snps$bp_cum[i]
      if (all(abs(pos - snps$bp_cum[kept]) > 15000000)) {
        kept <- c(kept, i)
      }
    }
    snps[kept, ]
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

factor_top_nonoverlapping <- factor_top_nonoverlapping %>% filter(SNP != "rs62389424" & SNP != "rs34495106")


# Create df for mapped genes

factor_genes <- fread("fuma/CANNABIS_FACTOR_genes.txt")

factor_genes_cum <- factor_genes %>% 
  rename(CHR = chr) %>% 
  filter(minGwasP <5e-8) %>% 
  mutate(mid = end - ((end - start)/2)) %>%   
  left_join(factor_cum, by = "CHR") %>% 
  mutate(bp_cum = mid + bp_add) 

## group loci that are close
threshold <- 20000000

factor_genes_top <- factor_genes_cum %>%
  group_by(CHR) %>%
  arrange(bp_cum) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = cumsum(ifelse(is.na(lag(bp_cum)) | (bp_cum - lag(bp_cum) > threshold), 1, 0))
  ) %>%
  group_by(CHR, Group) %>% 
  arrange(minGwasP, .by_group = T) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup()

dashedlines <- factor_genes_cum %>% 
  select(bp_cum)

x_coordinates <- eval(parse(text = as.character(dashedlines)))


```

# Separate frequency traits

For the supplementary figures, we now move on to per frequency trait Manhattan plots.

## Frequency lifetime

Total number of times someone has used cannabis in their life (European only).

```{r, eval = F}


frq_life <- fread("metal/MA_FREQ_LIFETIME_250919.txt.gz") 
frq_life_X <- fread("metal/MA_FREQ_LIFETIME_X_250409.txt")

frq_life <- rbind(frq_life, frq_life_X) %>% 
  mutate(CHR = ifelse(CHR == "X", 23, CHR),
         CHR = as.numeric(CHR))

frq_life_cum <- frq_life %>% 
  group_by(CHR) %>% 
  summarise(max_bp = max(BP)) %>% 
  mutate(bp_add = lag(cumsum(as.numeric(max_bp)), default = 0)) %>% 
  select(CHR, bp_add)

frq_life_data <- frq_life %>% 
  inner_join(frq_life_cum, by = "CHR") %>% 
  mutate(bp_cum = BP + bp_add) %>%
  mutate(uniqID = paste(CHR, BP, A1, A2, sep = ":"))

axis_set <- frq_life_data %>% 
  group_by(CHR) %>% 
  summarize(center = mean(bp_cum))

ylim <- frq_life_data %>% 
  filter(P == min(P)) %>% 
  mutate(ylim = abs(floor(log10(P))) + 10.5) %>% 
  pull(ylim)

# Clump hits

  filter(P<5e-8) %>%

  rename(eaf=EAF) %>% 
  rename(beta=BETA) %>%
```

## Non-European 

We also show the non-European only results, first from the meta-analysis (including AllOfUs and Helius cohorts), then for AllOfUs separately. 

### Meta-analysis

```{r, eval = F}


CANNABIS_EVR <- fread("metal/MA_CANNABIS_EVR_NONEUR_250704.txt.gz")

CANNABIS_EVR_cum <- CANNABIS_EVR %>% 
  mutate(CHR = ifelse(CHR == "X", 23, CHR)) %>% 
  mutate(CHR = as.numeric(CHR)) %>% 
  group_by(CHR) %>% 
  summarise(max_bp = max(BP)) %>% 
  mutate(bp_add = lag(cumsum(as.numeric(max_bp)), default = 0)) %>% 
  select(CHR, bp_add)

CANNABIS_EVR_data <- CANNABIS_EVR %>% 
  mutate(CHR = ifelse(CHR == "X", 23, CHR)) %>% 
  mutate(CHR = as.numeric(CHR)) %>% 
  inner_join(CANNABIS_EVR_cum, by = "CHR") %>% 
  mutate(bp_cum = BP + bp_add) %>%
  mutate(uniqID = paste(CHR, BP, A1, A2, sep = ":"))

axis_set <- CANNABIS_EVR_data %>% 
  group_by(CHR) %>% 
  summarize(center = mean(bp_cum))

ylim <- CANNABIS_EVR_data %>% 
  filter(P == min(P)) %>% 
  mutate(ylim = abs(floor(log10(P)))) %>% 
  pull(ylim)

ylim <- ylim + 2

sig <- 5e-8

# Use hits clumped with FUMA

CANNABIS_top <- CANNABIS_top %>% 
  rename(SNP = rsID) %>%

# Add genes mapped positionally with FUMA

  mutate(bp_cum = mid + bp_add) 

## group loci that are close

CANNABIS_EVR_genes_top <- CANNABIS_EVR_genes_cum %>%
  group_by(CHR) %>%
  arrange(bp_cum) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = cumsum(ifelse(is.na(lag(bp_cum)) | (bp_cum - lag(bp_cum) > threshold), 1, 0))
  ) %>%
  group_by(CHR, Group) %>% 
  arrange(minGwasP, .by_group = T) %>%
```

### AllOfUs

Because there were hits for both ever use and frequency for the non-European analysis in AllOfUs (from GENESIS), we present these results separately.

#### Ever use 

First, data are prepared for the AllOfUs results from GENESIS for ever use. 

```{r, eval = F}


CANNABIS_EVR <- fread("genesis/ALLOFUS.NONEUR.CANNABIS_EVR.EZQC.txt.gz")

CANNABIS_EVR_cum <- CANNABIS_EVR %>% 
  rename(BP = POS, A1 = EFFECT_ALLELE, A2 = OTHER_ALLELE, P = PVAL) %>%
  mutate(CHR = ifelse(CHR == "X", 23, CHR)) %>% 
  mutate(CHR = as.numeric(CHR)) %>% 
  group_by(CHR) %>% 
  summarise(max_bp = max(BP)) %>% 
  mutate(bp_add = lag(cumsum(as.numeric(max_bp)), default = 0)) %>% 
  select(CHR, bp_add)

CANNABIS_EVR_data <- CANNABIS_EVR %>% 
  rename(BP = POS, A1 = EFFECT_ALLELE, A2 = OTHER_ALLELE, P = PVAL) %>%
  mutate(CHR = ifelse(CHR == "X", 23, CHR)) %>% 
  mutate(CHR = as.numeric(CHR)) %>% 
  inner_join(CANNABIS_EVR_cum, by = "CHR") %>% 
  mutate(bp_cum = BP + bp_add) %>%
  mutate(uniqID = paste(CHR, BP, A1, A2, sep = ":"))

axis_set <- CANNABIS_EVR_data %>% 
  group_by(CHR) %>% 
  summarize(center = mean(bp_cum))

ylim <- CANNABIS_EVR_data %>% 
  filter(P == min(P)) %>% 
  mutate(ylim = abs(floor(log10(P))) + 10.5) %>% 
  pull(ylim)

sig <- 5e-8

# Use hits clumped with FUMA

CANNABIS_top <- fread("fuma/CANNABIS_EVR_noneur_AllOfUs_riskloci.txt")

CANNABIS_top <- CANNABIS_top %>% 
  rename(SNP = rsID) %>% 
  select(SNP) %>% 
  left_join(CANNABIS_EVR_data) 

CANNABIS_top_nonoverlapping <- CANNABIS_top %>%
  arrange(P) %>%  
  group_by(CHR) %>%  
  do({
    snps <- .
    kept <- c()
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(snps))) {
      pos <- snps$bp_cum[i]
      if (all(abs(pos - snps$bp_cum[kept]) > 15000000)) {
        kept <- c(kept, i)
      }
    }
    snps[kept, ]
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# Add genes mapped positionally with FUMA

CANNABIS_EVR_genes <- fread("fuma/CANNABIS_EVR_noneur_AllOfUs_genes.txt")

CANNABIS_EVR_genes_cum <- CANNABIS_EVR_genes %>% 
  rename(CHR = chr) %>% 
  filter(minGwasP <5e-8) %>% 
  mutate(mid = end - ((end - start)/2)) %>%   
  left_join(CANNABIS_EVR_cum, by = "CHR") %>% 
  mutate(bp_cum = mid + bp_add) 

## group loci that are close
threshold <- 10000000

CANNABIS_EVR_genes_top <- CANNABIS_EVR_genes_cum %>%
  group_by(CHR) %>%
  arrange(bp_cum) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = cumsum(ifelse(is.na(lag(bp_cum)) | (bp_cum - lag(bp_cum) > threshold), 1, 0))
  ) %>%
  group_by(CHR, Group) %>% 
  arrange(minGwasP, .by_group = T) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup()

# make some lines for exact gene position

dashedlines <- CANNABIS_EVR_genes_cum %>% 
  select(bp_cum)

x_coordinates <- eval(parse(text = as.character(dashedlines)))

# The PELP1 is still a bit too close to TOM1L2, so add that one separately

CANNABIS_EVR_genes_TOM1L2 <- CANNABIS_EVR_genes_top %>% filter(symbol == "TOM1L2")
CANNABIS_EVR_genes_top <- CANNABIS_EVR_genes_top %>% filter(symbol != "TOM1L2")

```

#### Recent frequency

AllOfUs also had a measure of recent frequency. 

```{r, eval = F}

FREQ_PAST <- fread("genesis/AllOfUs_v8_NonEUR_FREQ_PAST_formatted.csv.gz")

FREQ_PAST_cum <- FREQ_PAST %>% 
  rename(BP = POS) %>% 
  mutate(CHR = ifelse(CHR == "X", 23, CHR)) %>% 
  mutate(CHR = as.numeric(CHR)) %>% 
  group_by(CHR) %>% 
  summarise(max_bp = max(BP)) %>% 
  mutate(bp_add = lag(cumsum(as.numeric(max_bp)), default = 0)) %>% 
  select(CHR, bp_add)

FREQ_PAST_data <- FREQ_PAST %>% 
  rename(BP = POS) %>% 
  mutate(CHR = ifelse(CHR == "X", 23, CHR)) %>% 
  mutate(CHR = as.numeric(CHR)) %>% 
  inner_join(FREQ_PAST_cum, by = "CHR") %>% 
  mutate(bp_cum = BP + bp_add) %>%
  mutate(uniqID = paste(CHR, BP, A1, A2, sep = ":"))

axis_set <- FREQ_PAST_data %>% 
  group_by(CHR) %>% 
  summarize(center = mean(bp_cum))

ylim <- CANNABIS_EVR_data %>% 
  filter(P == min(P)) %>% 
  mutate(ylim = abs(floor(log10(P))) + 10.5) %>% 
  pull(ylim)

sig <- 5e-8


# Use hits clumped with FUMA

FREQ_PAST_top <- fread("fuma/FREQ_PAST_noneur_AllOfUs_riskloci.txt")

FREQ_PAST_top <- FREQ_PAST_top %>% 
  rename(SNP = rsID) %>% 
  select(SNP) %>% 
  left_join(FREQ_PAST_data) 

FREQ_PAST_top_nonoverlapping <- CANNABIS_top %>%
  arrange(P) %>%  
  group_by(CHR) %>%  
  do({
    snps <- .
    kept <- c()
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(snps))) {
      pos <- snps$bp_cum[i]
      if (all(abs(pos - snps$bp_cum[kept]) > 15000000)) {
        kept <- c(kept, i)
      }
    }
    snps[kept, ]
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# Add genes mapped positionally with FUMA

FREQ_PAST_genes <- fread("fuma/FREQ_PAST_noneur_AllOfUs_genes.txt")

FREQ_PAST_genes_cum <- FREQ_PAST_genes %>% 
  rename(CHR = chr) %>% 
  filter(minGwasP <5e-8) %>% 
  mutate(mid = end - ((end - start)/2)) %>%   
  left_join(CANNABIS_EVR_cum, by = "CHR") %>% 
  mutate(bp_cum = mid + bp_add) 

## group loci that are close
threshold <- 10000000

FREQ_PAST_genes_top <- FREQ_PAST_genes_cum %>%
  group_by(CHR) %>%
  arrange(bp_cum) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = cumsum(ifelse(is.na(lag(bp_cum)) | (bp_cum - lag(bp_cum) > threshold), 1, 0))
  ) %>%
  group_by(CHR, Group) %>% 
  arrange(minGwasP, .by_group = T) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup()

# make some lines for exact gene position

dashedlines <- CANNABIS_EVR_genes_cum %>% 
  select(bp_cum)

x_coordinates <- eval(parse(text = as.character(dashedlines)))


```
